The function\n *        apart from handling any normal data, also handles ipv4/ipv6 netblocks\n *\n * \\param key_stream  Data that has to be found in the Radix tree\n * \\param tree        Pointer to the Radix tree\n * \\param exact_match The key to be searched is an ip address\n */\nstatic RADIX_NODE_TYPE *FindKey(const RADIX_TREE_TYPE *tree, const uint8_t *key_stream,\n        const uint8_t netmask, bool exact_match, void **user_data_result, uint8_t *out_netmask)\n{\n    if (tree == NULL || tree->head == NULL)\n        return NULL;\n\n    RADIX_NODE_TYPE *node = tree->head;\n    uint8_t tmp_stream[ADDRESS_BYTES];\n    memcpy(tmp_stream, key_stream, sizeof(tmp_stream));\n\n    while (node->bit < NETMASK_MAX) {\n        if (RADIX_BITTEST(tmp_stream[node->bit >> 3], (0x80 >> (node->bit % 8)))) {\n            node = node->right;\n        } else {\n            node = node->left;\n        }\n\n        if (node == NULL) {\n            return NULL;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (node->bit != NETMASK_MAX || !node->has_prefix) {\n        return NULL;\n    }\n\n    if (SCMemcmp(node->prefix_stream, tmp_stream, sizeof(tmp_stream)) == 0) {\n        SCLogDebug(\"stream match\");\n        if (ContainNetmaskAndSetUserData(node, netmask, true, user_data_result)) {\n            SCLogDebug(\"contains netmask etc\");\n            *out_netmask = netmask;\n            return node;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /* if you are not an ip key, get out of here */\n    if (exact_match) {\n        SCLogDebug(\"no node found and need exact match, so failed\");\n        return NULL;\n    }\n\n    RADIX_NODE_TYPE *ret = FindKeyIPNetblock(tmp_stream, node, user_data_result, out_netmask);\n    return ret;\n}\n\n/**\n * \\brief Checks if an IPV4 address is present in the tree\n *\n * \\param key_stream Data that has to be found in the Radix tree. byte order.\n\n    Returns the prefix length, or -1 when the mask is not a valid prefix.\n    \"\"\"\n    # ntohl() of the network-order value == the big-endian interpretation.\n    netmask = netmask_net_order\n    if netmask == 0:\n        return 0\n    p = 0\n    seen_1 = False\n    while netmask > 0:\n        if netmask & 1:\n            seen_1 = True\n            p += 1\n We reproduce the\n    value this host's htonl() would produce.\n    \"\"\"\n    if cidr <= 0 or cidr > 32:\n        return 0\n    shifted = (0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - cidr)) & 0xFFFFFFFF\n    # htonl(): swap on a little-endian host, identity on big-endian.\n    if sys.byteorder == \"little\":\n        return int.from_bytes(shifted.to_bytes(4, \"big\"), \"little\")\n    return shifted\n\n\ndef cidr_get_ipv6(cidr):\n    \"\"\"CIDRGetIPv6(): returns the 16-byte in6_addr mask as a bytearray.\"\"\"\n    in6 = bytearray(16)\n    i = 0\n\n    while cidr > 8:\n        if i >= 16:  # C would run off the end; unreachable for cidr <= 128\n            break\n        in6[i] = 0xFF\n        cidr -= 8\n        i += 1\n\n    while cidr > 0:\n        if i >= 16:\n            break\n        in6[i] |= 0x80\n        cidr -= 1\n        if cidr > 0:\n            in6[i] = in6[i] >> 1\n\n    return in6\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# src/util-ip.c\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef mask_ip_netblock(stream, netmask, key_bitlen):\n    \"\"\"MaskIPNetblock(): chop an address against a netmask, in place.\"\"\"\n    nbytes = key_bitlen // 8\n    for i in range(nbytes):\n        mask = 0xFFFFFFFF\n        if ((i + 1) * 8) > netmask:\n            if ((i + 1) * 8 - netmask) < 8:\n                mask = (0xFFFFFFFF << ((i + 1) * 8 - netmask)) & 0xFFFFFFFF\n            else:\n                mask = 0\n        # stream[] is uint8_t, so the store truncates to the low byte.\n        stream[i] &= mask & 0xFF\n\n\ndef bittest(stream, bit):\n    \"\"\"RADIX_BITTEST(stream[bit >> 3], 0x80 >> (bit % 8)).\"\"\"\n    return stream[bit >> 3] & (0x80 >> (bit % 8))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# src/util-radix-tree-common.h -- shared radix implementation.
